subject: Seller onboarding forms + PO routing — StrataSoft (AWS/GCP listing)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@stratasoft.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Listing intake + procurement questions for AWS/GCP marketplaces

Hi Ava / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — excited to get StrataSoft listed across AWS and GCP. Procurement has a couple of asks before we can issue a PO:

- Can you confirm your marketplace billing entity and legal name for tax documents?
- We need the typical payables contact and a PDF of your marketplace onboarding packet (forms we need for vendor setup).
- Any standard PO routing instructions for multi-cloud listings? Does Redwood accept a marketplace PO that references the vendor platform, or do you need a separate Redwood invoice?

If helpful I can loop in our procurement team directly. Would like to receive the onboarding form and a PO routing note by EOD Friday.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, StrataSoft
[attachment: Strata_Seller_Intent.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@stratasoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-05T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Listing intake + procurement questions for AWS/GCP marketplaces

Hi Elena — great talking yesterday. Quick answers below and attached the standard intake form.

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing entity for marketplace listings is the same, but invoice flow depends on the specific marketplace (we can support vendor-of-record vs. marketplace-billing models).
- Payables contact: finance+payables@redwood.ai (for direct invoices). For marketplace POs we typically accept the marketplace PO number as a reference; however for Reserved/Dedicated contracts we require a Redwood invoice reflecting the committed charge.

Attached: Strata_Onboarding_Form.pdf — please fill sections A/B and return. I also attached our PO routing cheat sheet (Redwood_Marketplace_PO_Routing.docx) which lists per-cloud instructions and examples of how we prefer PO line items to be structured.

Next steps:
1) Elena/Strata to return form + initial PO intent statement
2) Ben/Vanessa to validate marketplace listing tier and confirm whether vendor-of-record is required for AWS Marketplace
3) Finance to confirm net-30 payment terms once PO is received

If procurement wants to send their questions directly, happy to engage.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Strata_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Procurement <procurement@stratasoft.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-06T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Listing intake + procurement questions for AWS/GCP marketplaces

Hi Ava / Ben,

Thanks for the form — we've reviewed it and have two clarifying items:

1) On the tax form you list Redwood Inference, Inc. as the billing entity. Can you provide W-9 (for US) or equivalent tax certificates for EU operations?
2) For AWS Marketplace specifically: we issue a marketplace PO to the platform (AWS), is that acceptable as the contractual PO reference, or do you require a separate Redwood PO to be raised by our AP team?

Also attaching our internal vendor intake checklist so you can see the items we will push back on if missing.

Procurement will aim to issue an initial PO (draft) by 9/7 if answers above are ready.

Regards,
Maria Torres
Vendor Operations, StrataSoft
[attachment: Strata_Vendor_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-06T10:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: PO routing decision and AWS vendor-of-record

Ava / Vanessa — quick internal note after Maria's questions:

- W-9: Finance can provide the current W-9 (I have a copy, will attach to the reply).
- AWS vendor-of-record: For Strata's scale I recommend we accept the marketplace PO as a reference and set invoice to Redwood for any reserved capacity. Vanessa — can you confirm if we should require SOW/invoice for the reserved commit portion?
- Risk: If Strata opts for vendor-of-record we need legal to sign onboarding terms; that will add ~2 weeks.

Action items for this thread:
- Vanessa: add the final PO routing paragraph and sample PO line to send to Strata (so their AP can map to their system).
- Karthik: if there's any platform-side listing gating (AWS org requirements) flag it here.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Torres <procurement@stratasoft.com>, Elena Morales <elena@stratasoft.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-07T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Listing intake + procurement questions for AWS/GCP marketplaces

Hi Maria / Elena — thanks for the checklist. See answers below and attached sample PO:

- W-9/W-8: Attached is our current W-9 (for US billing) and a note on EU VAT handling.
- Marketplace PO handling: We can accept the Marketplace PO number as a reference for listing fees and pay-as-you-go charges. For Reserved/Dedicated commitments we need Redwood to be the billed entity — please include a separate PO line referencing "Redwood Inference, Inc. — Reserved Commitment" so our finance team can reconcile.
- Sample PO line (for Strata to map into AP system):
  - Account: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  - Description: Listing fee / AWS Marketplace referencing Marketplace PO #{marketplace_po}
  - Amount: TBD
  - Payment terms: Net 30

Attached: Redwood_Marketplace_PO_Routing.docx (contains per-cloud examples) and Strata_PO_987654.pdf (placeholder for draft PO). Once you return the completed Strata_Onboarding_Form.pdf and the draft PO with the PO number mapped in one of the sample lines above, finance will issue a formal invoice or accept the marketplace-as-reference model depending on commitment.

If you want I can set a 20-minute call with finance to walk through the sample PO mapping.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Finance & Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_PO_Routing.docx, Strata_PO_987654.pdf, W-9_Redwood.pdf]
